subject: Cloud Computing
title: Cloud Cost Forecasting
description: A short lesson to help you apply Cloud Cost Forecasting.

hook.text: Last month's cloud bill was $100,000. Next month it could be $80,000 or $200,000. Nobody knows. That's a problem.

buildup.text: Cost forecasting uses historical usage patterns and growth trends to predict future cloud spending.

discovery.text: Cloud providers offer forecasting tools: AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, and GCP billing reports.

twist.text: Forecasts break down when usage changes suddenly. A new feature launch or viral moment makes predictions useless.

climax.text: Good forecasting combines automated tools with human judgment. Machines spot trends; humans know what's planned.

punchline.text: Predicting cloud costs is hard. Not trying is harder.

quiz.question: Why do cloud cost forecasts often fail?
options: Sudden usage changes from new features or viral events break historical patterns
Cloud providers intentionally hide pricing information
Forecasting tools are only available to enterprise customers

details.summary: Cloud cost forecasting predicts future spending based on historical trends, planned growth, reservations, and pricing changes. Accurate forecasting prevents budget overruns and supports procurement decisions for reserved capacity or enterprise agreements.
details.whyItMatters: Without forecasting, cloud budgets are guesswork. Unexpected overruns trigger emergency cost cuts that disrupt engineering. Good forecasts enable proactive financial planning.
takeaways: Predicts future spending from historical data and growth plans
Prevents budget overruns and supports reservation purchases
Cloud provider tools and third-party platforms assist forecasting

faq.question: How accurate are cloud cost forecasts?
faq.answer: With good historical data and stable growth, forecasts within 10 to 15 percent accuracy are achievable for the next quarter. Longer-term forecasts are less reliable due to pricing changes, new services, and business pivots. Regular recalibration improves accuracy.

faq.question: What tools help forecast cloud costs?
faq.answer: AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, and Google Cloud billing all include forecasting features. Third-party tools like Apptio Cloudability, Vantage, and CloudHealth provide more sophisticated multi-cloud forecasting and scenario modeling.
